episode_row: C-01 leaderboard parser stored active streak in all_season/all_time rows

commits.subject: fix(leaderboard): tab-specific streak semantics + explicit streak columns + envelope validation (C-01)
commits.body:
parse_leaderboard_response preferred activeStreak over streak for EVERY tab,
so the daily snapshots' all_season / all_time rows recorded the ACTIVE streak
instead of the tab's ranking quantity (7/04 snapshot: 9/100 all_season rows
equal the profile best_streak; fixture user 441 best 34 parsed as 2). Found
by Codex during the final-grab wrapper design review, confirmed on box data.

- streak = tab-semantic (season best on all_season, all-time best on all_time,
  active streak on active_streak / yesterday); new nullable columns
  season_best_streak + active_streak carry both raw values.
- Error-only / malformed bodies raise LeaderboardEnvelopeError instead of
  parsing as an empty board.
- Historical parquet files are NOT rewritten; docs/audit/2026-09-corrections-index.md
  C-01 records the defect and the reading rule.
